source_anomalies.issue: Ordinary range cells omit तक in the source. The transcription preserves this omission rather than appending text.
Combined पटखौली पूरब + एलासगढ़ name has one 1-to-11 range; no separate village ranges inferred.
The second component prints an extra 0 before the starting 1. Preserved literally as वार्ड सं0-0 1 से 11 तक, without silently recoding it.
Source boundary ends बाराबांध का 13; retained without manufacturing a conventional range.
Source name बलीपुर + सराँक differs from boundary spellings बलिपुर and सरांक. Source variants preserved without canonical merging.

method: Direct visual reading of source name/boundary columns on physical pages 54-74, with 400-DPI source crops for 19 targeted readings.
name_normalization: No canonical geographic name mapping; source variants retained
boundary_normalization: Whitespace and dash only; source presence or absence of तक, compound descriptions and leading zeros retained
